author: Nichole Ifill
content:
Hello Lopez & team!

Once again thank you SO much for supplying us with your equipment for my sons 2nd birthday. When he saw the bouncy castle he exclaimed "wow mummy, wow, thank you!".

For the second time you have exceeded my expectations and delivered exceptional professionalism and you're definitely a company I can ALWAYS rely on.

The children had a blast and everybody went home exhausted.

**I CAN AND ALWAYS WILL HIGHLY RECOMMEND DANCING CUBS AS THEY ARE RELIABLE, PUNCTUAL AND PROFESSIONAL TO NAME A FEW!!!**
